overlay_centring_fix.reported_by: user: overlay menu is not centered when widescreen is on
overlay_centring_fix.cause: Video::new hardcoded view_left: 0 and set_view_width was never called, so the painter drew guest columns 0..239 on a 320-wide surface; the menu appeared near the left edge
overlay_centring_fix.also_found: changing [video] view_width while running had no effect (dead set_view_width, pixel buffer allocated once)
overlay_centring_fix.fix: view_left threaded from create_video; set_view_width invoked on settings apply with the guest retargeted via apply_view; ensure_pixels resizes the host buffer; Painter::fill_surface covers the margins for the menu backdrop and pause band
overlay_centring_fix.verification: sdl::spec069_paint tests (shifted by view_left, no-op at native, full-width backdrop) and a simulated 320-wide overlay: panel guest 2..238 renders at output columns 42..277, centre 159.5, equal to the canonical crop centre; the panel stays inside crop 40..279
overlay_centring_fix.limits: verified by geometry tests and a simulated render, not by inspecting the live window

override_ui_sync_fix.reported_by: user: the setting does not seem in sync with the flag passed on the cli
override_ui_sync_fix.cause: the menu showed Settings.video.view_width (persisted, 240) while the surface was forced to 320 by --view-width; Apply persisted the draft, silently discarding the override and snapping the display back
override_ui_sync_fix.fix: Menu::set_view_override(width, persisted) labels the row '320 px (forcado)'; an explicit row edit supersedes the override and persists; a bare Apply restores the persisted value so the override never reaches settings.toml (WS-69-18); native menu marks the forced item; gba-settings receives --session-view-width as advisory text because it is a separate process
override_ui_sync_fix.limits: verified by unit tests over the menu model; the on-screen menu was not visually inspected
